questions.q: Which of these is primary research?
questions.why: Primary research collects original, first-hand data; the others already exist.

questions.q: A company's sales are $2 million in a market with total sales of $8 million. What is its market share?

options: Every person has an equal chance of being chosen
Data already collected by another organisation
People chosen because they have certain characteristics, e.g. age
questions.why: A quota sample selects people by characteristics; equal chance describes a random sample.

questions.model: An identifiable sub-group of a whole market in which consumers have similar characteristics or preferences.
